school.name: Leon M. Goldstein High School for the Sciences
school.overview:
Our school shares a campus with Kingsborough Community College. All students study math and science each year and three years of of a World Language as a high school student. Additionally, all 9th and 10th grade students are required to take computer science courses. We offer a variety of Advanced Placement classes along with College Now Classes available for tenth and eleventh grade students and required College Now for all seniors.

Our school is part of the Diversity in Admissions (DIA): Students are admitted in rank order by zip code.  There are no priority zip codes for our school.

programs.description: An enriching and challenging curriculum in math, sciences, and humanities that exceeds city and state requirements.
